summary: We, as a team, have created a game that has the concept of living on Mars through farming and etc. As a player you are required to carry out the assigned tasks while facing several obstacles such as radiation that lowers your radiation shield, energy, oxygen and even wind storms. Remember you have one health bar. This game aims to simulate life on Mars through our team's collaboration with artificial intelligence. Every day, our game will evaluate the player on whether or not they have successfully completed the mission by grading them.
details:
This game uses artificial intelligence, namely chatgpt and Gemini AI, which helps us code the games.

It is recommended to be played in landscape view(mobile), laptop or computer.
